title: Welcome Guide - International Student Services - Purdue University Northwest
text:
Purdue University Northwest
>
International Student Services
>
Welcome Guide
Welcome Guide
Welcome! We are here to support you on your journey to the United States and help you adjust.
Welcome “Home” to Purdue Northwest!
We highly recommend the PNW on-campus student housing in University Village and Calumet Hall. Located on the Hammond campus, our residence halls offer safe, affordable options within walking distance to classes, the fitness center, the dining hall, the library, student activities and more.
Explore PNW Housing
Immunization Information: International Students in PNW Housing
As an incoming international student, I appreciated the chance to hear directly from someone who had already gone through the same transition.
Parikshith Saraswathi, M.S. in Computer Science
Arrival to Campus and Airport Pick-Up
PNW will offer free airport pick-up service for new international students from Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) to Purdue Northwest on
Jan. 5 and 6, 2027
PNW will not offer a pick-up service outside of these dates.
If you will not arrive during these dates, PNW cannot offer a free pick-up service. However, many community members reported a positive experience with the transportation services listed below.
This is not a comprehensive list and they are not endorsed by PNW.
Private Car Service
Avanti Goldstar Limousine and Airport Transportation
Telephone: (708) 477-9656
Drivin Ms. Dazy
(219) 613-6028
Taxi service from O’Hare Airport
Find taxi information at O’Hare
Taxi, Limo, TNP | Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) (flychicago.com)
Local taxi near PNW
Yellow Cab
(219) 932-9999
Mandatory Check-In and New International Student Orientation
New International Student Orientation: Aug. 21, 2026
Once you arrive in the US, one of the first things you do is log in to your MyISS account and complete the mandatory check-in for international students in the vMISCI section. If you have any questions, please contact the Office of Immigration Services in Lawshe Hall 226.
Please bring the following:
Your passport, with the appropriate student/scholar visa
Your Certificate of Eligibility (I-20 or DS-2019)
Any other immigration-related documents that you have obtained, such as from the Customs and Border Patrol Agents or any previous schools you may have attended
Have questions regarding your immigration documents or SEVIS check-in? Email
iss@pnw.edu
.
Sign up for orientation
Health Insurance
All international undergraduate and graduate students who are registered, regardless of credit hours, or in an approved professional certificate program must enroll in the mandatory university health insurance plan unless they meet the criteria for a waiver.
Learn More About Health Insurance
Connect with a Current Student
Have questions about the international student experience at Purdue University Northwest? Schedule an online meeting with a current student to learn more!
Schedule a Meeting
